title: Galoli language - Wikipedia
text: The Galoli, or Galolen, is a language of the East Timorese with a population of around 50,000, mainly along the northern coast of the Manatuto district. To the west lies the Mambai language. There is an old colony on the southern coast of Wetar island, the Talo people, who speak the Talur dialect. The Galoli language is one of the Timor–Babar group of Austronesian languages.
